title: Juicy Velvety Turkish Lamb Kofte
description: A traditional Turkish dish featuring lamb kofte with a velvety texture and earthy flavors, perfect for a hangover cure. This recipe uses coco sugar and is egg-free friendly, served in a ssam-wrap style.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, coco sugar, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Do not overmix the meat mixture.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
When ready to cook, remove the meat mixture from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Use your hands to shape the meat mixture into small cylindrical kofte, about 1 1/2 inches long and 1 inch in diameter.
Place the kofte on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving a little space between each kofte to allow for even cooking.
Bake the kofte in the preheated oven for 18-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the kofte are cooking, warm the ssam wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Once the kofte are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the kofte in the warmed ssam wraps, garnished with your choice of toppings such as chopped fresh herbs or sliced vegetables.
